reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jessenia Irizarry
reviewSamples.text: I can’t express enough how beautiful the cake was. I shared my idea with you, and you brought my vision to life beyond anything I imagined. And the taste—absolutely delicious! Thank you for helping make my daughter’s 21st birthday unforgettable.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Anthony Ortega
reviewSamples.text: Kenny’s Cakes was very great to deal with. They are very accommodating with our requests. The cake came out perfect and it was exactly what we wanted. Every communication they were always awesome in service. I would without a doubt use them for all our cake needs.
